transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
It's this cough, doctor. It just won't go away.
When did you first notice the cough?
It started a while back, not long after I had a cold.
Do you have any allergies, including to medicines?
No, I don't have any allergies that I know of, including to medicines.
How much is the cough getting in the way of your usual daily activities?
It's not too bad in the day, but it's been disturbing my sleep most nights.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take regularly or have started recently, and about any past health problems, operations, or hospital stays?
I use a couple of inhalers for my chest, and some tablets for my blood pressure. I've had a chest problem, COPD, for a good few years now.
Would you say the cough is mild, moderate, or severe, or are you not sure?
I'd say somewhere in the middle, maybe a 6 out of 10.
Since the cough started, what else, if anything, have you noticed going on with your health?
I get a bit more breathless than usual walking to the shop. Otherwise I've not noticed anything else.
Where do you feel the cough most, and does it spread anywhere else?
It's just in my chest, really. I haven't noticed it spreading anywhere else.
What have you noticed makes your cough better or worse—for example, activities, positions, foods, or medicines?
Cold air sets it off, and talking for a long time too. Steam inhalation seems to help a little.
Apart from your long-standing chest problem and your blood pressure, is there anything else you see a doctor or nurse about regularly, or any operations or hospital stays you’ve had in the past?
No, nothing else that I recall. Just the COPD and the blood pressure, no operations or hospital stays.
What worries you most about this cough, and can you describe what the cough itself feels like to you?
I'm worried my lungs are getting worse, or that it could be cancer. The cough brings up phlegm that's white to yellow.
When did this cough first start, and did it come on suddenly or gradually—was there anything you noticed that set it off around that time?
It was about three weeks ago now, and it came on gradually after I had a cold.
Can you tell me what medicines you take regularly for your chest and blood pressure, and whether you’ve started or changed anything recently—including the doses if you know them?

I use a blue salbutamol inhaler, a Fostair 100/6 inhaler two puffs twice a day, and lisinopril 10 mg once a day for my blood pressure. I have been using the blue inhaler more than usual lately, maybe four or five times a day.
Besides the inhalers and the blood pressure tablet you mentioned, are you taking any other medicines for your chest or other health conditions, even ones you only use now and then?
No, that's everything. I'm not on anything else, even now and then.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
